notes.title: Hey, I made a cute little fishing game.
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40929621/d9dc24c3be4a22749b0a4cc42c31dd824504204e.png[/img]

My next game is coming soon and will be released by Oakrot Games on Steam. It's called [b]Fishing Game[/b].

Fishing game is an itty bitty game inspired by the fishing minigame in Stardew Valley and Animal Crossing. I really loved the fishing mini game in Stardew Valley and Animal Crossing and made a game trying to smush the two together. It’s got a bunch of goofy writing and a handful of spicy gimmicks. I would really appreciate it if you would check out the game’s store page and Wishlist it.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2112150/Fishing_Game/

Hope you guys enjoy it!

You can follow Oakrot Games on social media to see Fishing Game teasers planned until the game releases near the end of the month.

notes.title: Pizza Apocalypse - Wishlist now!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=zI0Q1JGA14U;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][u][b]What is Pizza Apocalypse?[/b][/u][/h2]

[h3][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1706710/Pizza_Apocalypse/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1706710/Pizza_Apocalypse/[/url][/b][/h3]

In Pizza Apocalypse, you take control of 3 daring delivery people armed with a chef certified arsenal of deadly weapons and gadgets.

Delivering Pizza in the mutant monster apocalypse can be tough, your troops must work together to survive and combo the many abilities at their disposal for tremendous results!

But be wary, for the mutants possess powerful abilities and unique combos of their own. In order to ensure every delivery arrives in tip-top condition, your troops must guard each other from incoming attacks whilst also picking the enemies off and strategizing which enemies pose the greatest threat to you...

With a unique, colourful, and sometimes gruesome art style by Louis Morel, Pizza Apocalypse gives an insight into a crazy post-apocalyptic world filled with interesting characters who wish only to enjoy the sweet sweet taste of cheesy dough from a world before it came to an end, happy delivering!

[h2][u][b]How can I stay up to date?[/b][/u][/h2]

Click the link below to join Louis Morel's new discord server!

[h3][b][url=https://discord.gg/sezrycYhhQ]https://discord.gg/sezrycYhhQ[/url][/b][/h3]

Not only will you get exclusive access to development diaries and have your say on future games, but you'll also be part of a growing community of like-minded people - where you can make new friends, share your own artwork and much, much more! There are dedicated text channels for each of Louis' games, and behind the scenes access to ongoing projects - with plenty of topics and fun things to get involved in!

You can also follow the shiny new [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/louismorel]Louis Morel[/url] developer page on Steam. This gives you access to all of Louis' released and upcoming games in one place!
